request: attendance register for my class, I mark who is absent each day and see how many came
program:
app "Attendance" users ocean
table student name text
table absent student ref student
state d date = today
row align center
  button "<" tap set d = d - 1
  dayname(d) monthday(d) monthname(d) head grow align center
  button ">" tap set d = d + 1
count(student) - count(absent on d) "of" count(student) "present" big
grid 4 gap 1
  each student sort name as s
    stack radius 8 pad 1 fill if(count(s.absent on d) > 0, bad, good) tap toggle s.absent on d
      s.name bold align center color bg
      if(count(s.absent on d) > 0, "Absent", "Present") tiny align center color bg
"Tap a name to mark absent. Everyone starts present." faint
each student sort name as s
  row
    s.name grow
    count(s.absent month of d) "days absent this month" faint
form student, "Add student"

request: monthly budget, I add expenses with a category and see how much of my budget is left this month
program:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
state m date = today
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form spend
list spend month of m by day

request: cricket scorer: tap the runs for each ball, count wides and wickets, show the score and overs
program:
app "Scorer" ball ocean
table ball runs num 0..6, wide bool, out bool
let r = sum(ball.runs all)
let w = count(ball where wide = yes)
join(r, "/", w) big
"Overs" floor(count(ball) / 6) "." count(ball) % 6 faint

request: habit tracker where I tick my habits every day and see my streaks
program:
app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
count(check today) "of" n "done today" head
if n = 0
  "Nothing to track yet. Add one." faint
each habit
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      streak(it.check) "day streak," round(count(it.check last 30 days) * 100 / 30) "% in 30 days" faint
    toggle it.check
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% in 30 days"
  stat max(habit, streak(it.check)), "best streak"
heat last 70 days, count(check on it), n
form habit

request: daily journal with my mood and a note, and I can search old entries
program:
app "Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1
  each ["Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day
"Saved on this device only." faint

request: a quiz: I add questions with three choices and the right answer, then answer them and see my score
program:
app "Quiz" star plum
table item question text, a text, b text, c text, right pick A|B|C
table answer item ref item, chose pick A|B|C
let score = count(answer, it.chose = it.item.right)
score "of" count(answer) "right" big
each item as x
  if count(x.answer) = 0
    stack card gap 1
      x.question head
      button x.a tap add answer item = x, chose = A
      button x.b tap add answer item = x, chose = B
      button x.c tap add answer item = x, chose = C
each answer as r
  row
    r.item.question grow
    if(r.chose = r.item.right, "Right", "Wrong") color if(r.chose = r.item.right, good, bad)
form item, "Add question"

request: reading list: books I want to read, am reading and have finished
program:
app "Reading" book plum
table book title text, author text?, status pick Want|Reading|Done = Want, finished date?
state tab text = Reading
row gap 1
  each options book.status
    button it fill if(tab = it, accent, soft) tap set tab = it
each book where status = tab sort title as b
  row card tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow
      b.title bold
      b.author faint
    if b.status = Reading
      button "Finished" tap set b.status = Done then set b.finished = today
form book

request: savings goal: I add deposits and see how close I am to my goal
program:
app "Savings" coin mint

setting goal money = 100000 "Savings goal"

row gap 3

request: tasbeeh counter for SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar, 33 each
program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads mint
table zikr phrase pick SubhanAllah|Alhamdulillah|AllahuAkbar = SubhanAllah
setting target num = 33 "Count to"
state ph text = SubhanAllah
let n = count(zikr today where phrase = ph)
row gap 1
  each options zikr.phrase
    button it fill if(ph = it, accent, soft) tap set ph = it
draw width 240 tap add zikr phrase = ph
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
when n > 0 and n % target = 0 notify "Round complete"
"Tap the circle to count." count(zikr today) "today in all." faint

request: tic tac toe game for two players
program:
app "Daily Tic tac toe" board ink
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = mark and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: to do list with due dates, home and work tags, and show which tasks are late
program:
app "To do" list slate
table task title text, due date?, done bool, tag pick Home|Work|Other = Home
let late = count(task where done = no and due < today)
count(task where done = no) "open," late "late" head color if(late > 0, warn, ink)
each task where done = no sort due as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.tag t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
remind "You have tasks due today" at 8:00 if count(task where done = no and due = today) > 0
form task
"Done" faint
list task where done = yes
